messages.subject: Stan is coming to RStudio!
parts: RStudio has a PR for syntax highlighting for .stan files! https://github.com/rstudio/rstudio/pull/324. They are asking whether there is a reasonable function for a one-click "source" button. Comment there if you have any ideas.

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Stan is coming to RStudio!
parts:
Yes, I believe JJ has made it can stanc on the file in the active tab.

Jeffrey (or anyone), if you are still interested in enhancing this for the RStudio-after-next version. The rstan on GitHub (which also has been uploaded to CRAN) has as its sysdata.rda file a data.frame called rosetta, that is derived from rstan/tools/stan-functions.txt. Its structure looks like this

> head(rstan:::rosetta)
  RFunction StanFunction            Arguments ReturnType Page
1       abs          abs              (int x)        int  279
2       abs          abs             (real x)       real  288
3     acosh        acosh             (real x)       real  293
4      acos         acos             (real x)       real  292
5     cbind   append_col (matrix x, matrix y)     matrix  321
6     cbind   append_col (matrix x, vector y)     matrix  321

Possibly with all the new features of RStudio 0.99 preview, it would be possible to highlight the function names in the second column and / or do code completion or argument hints for the third column. The rstan package now has a user-facing function called lookup() that does partial matching of the R function in the first column with the analagous Stan function in the second column.

Ben
